items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: The Robichaux's band came up? ... Yeah, Backe and Robichaux and Contrat I think was playing drums.

ctx.x: When was that you heard, George Backe?
That was about 19, 19, 19, 19, somewhere around that time. I imagine it was long in that time. The Robichaux's band came up?
Yeah, Robichaux, yeah, yeah. He played like a clarinet solo on that, huh?
